JustAnotherTranslator is a COM3D2 translation plugin, abbreviated as JAT. The JAT plugin does not provide translated text; please find and add it yourself.

Please see the README.md file for detailed instructions. If you can't open it, search for "Markdown Online Preview" in your browser and upload it, or open it in Notepad and copy the contents. 

such as https://markdownviewer.pages.dev/

Of course, the easiest way is to visit the repository below to view the online version directly.

Repository: https://github.com/MeidoPromotionAssociation/COM3D2.JustAnotherTranslator.Plugin

Online Documentation: https://github.com/MeidoPromotionAssociation/COM3D2.JustAnotherTranslator.Plugin/tree/main/Document

Get updates or report issues: https://github.com/MeidoPromotionAssociation/COM3D2.JustAnotherTranslator.Plugin

The local documentation is located in the following path: "COM3D2\BepInEx\JustAnotherTranslator\Document"


Important for none Chinese, Japanese and Korean languages users: Please manually enable EnableNoneCJKFix/启用非CJK语言修复 under [10Fixer]. If this optional fix is not enabled, some UI may show text compressed together, overlapping, or with spaces inserted between every character.



JustAnotherTranslator 是一个 COM3D2 翻译插件，简称 JAT，JAT 插件并不提供翻译文本，请自行寻找并添加。

详细说明请查看 README.md，如果打不开，请浏览器搜索”markdown在线预览“ 上传或把用记事本打开并把内容复制进去

例如 https://markdownviewer.pages.dev/

当然最简单的方法是访问下面的仓库地址，直接查看在线版本。

如果您打不开 github，请浏览器搜索 github 加速。


仓库地址：https://github.com/MeidoPromotionAssociation/COM3D2.JustAnotherTranslator.Plugin

在线文档：https://github.com/MeidoPromotionAssociation/COM3D2.JustAnotherTranslator.Plugin/tree/main/Document

获取更新或报告问题：https://github.com/MeidoPromotionAssociation/COM3D2.JustAnotherTranslator.Plugin

本地文档位于以下路径："COM3D2\BepInEx\JustAnotherTranslator\Document文档"

非中日韩语言用户请注意： 请手动启用 [10Fixer] 下的 EnableNoneCJKFix/启用非CJK语言修复。如果未启用此可选修复，部分界面可能会出现文字挤在一起、重叠，或者文字之间被自动插入空格的情况。
